body:
**Tier:** T4 (user-generated-content safety, moderation actions that remove content and member access, Apple App Review 1.2 release blocker). Never lowered.
**Why:** Store-package review: community posts, comments and DMs had no Block, Report existed only on challenge comments, the coach moderation queue called routes that never existed, there was no published safety contact, and the 422 content-filter rejection was not handled. Fix round 3 (lane B-UGC, agent 110) closes the Opus audit findings (B-314-1, C-314-1..3) and, per the owner decision of 20:32, makes **voice notes reportable in this PR directly so they can be ON at launch**: Report on every voice note, Block, author Delete, playback in the coach queue. Pairs with backend #610.
**T4 trigger scan:**
- Moderation: coach queue uses `PATCH /community/moderation/items/:id` with `hide | warn | ban | dismiss`, each behind a confirmation naming the content ("Hide this voice note from Sam?"); optimistic removal with rollback. Queue rows now accept `post | message | voice_note | win`; a reported voice note plays inline (server-signed 15-minute link); every row shows the 24-hour review status ("Review within 5h" / "Past 24 hours, review now"). Before this round the queue schema allowed only `post | message`, so one voice-note or win report would have failed the whole queue parse.
- Block: unchanged routes; confirm copy is two-way and now accurate for voice notes ("...posts, comments, messages or voice notes..."), because voice notes ship with Block.
- Report: reason sheet -> `POST /community/moderation/reports { target_type: post|comment|message|voice_note|win, target_id, reason }` with Idempotency-Key.
- Author delete (new): the viewer's own win or voice note gets a menu with Delete only (no Report/Block), confirmed with "Delete this voice note? It will be removed for everyone in your community. This cannot be undone."; failures say what happened and the next step.
- Native microphone (round 4): expo-audio recorder, foreground only (background recording and playback off in the config plugin), permission text "The Growth Project uses your microphone only while you record a voice note for your coaching community."; a permanent refusal points to Settings.
- Member notices (round 4): Hide / Warn / Ban notices are shown to the member in Community safety (`GET /community/safety/notices`, marked read on view); the coach queue states whether the notice was stored instead of claiming "Warning sent."
- Content filter: `422 community.content.rejected` shows the server message and keeps the draft (posts, comments, DMs, and now wins).
- Errors: every failure on these surfaces goes through `describeCommunityFailure`: known codes get specific copy (this round adds `community.dm.blocked_by_you`, `community.win.*`, `community.voice.*`); unknown errors show a short reference (X-Request-ID), the support address and go to Sentry.
**T3 (round 5):** consumes #610 round 5: maps `409 community.moderation.already_actioned` (server wording, which names the current action) and `409 community.moderation.changed` to copy with a next step. The recorder hook gains an `error` state (`{kind, reference}`) that the composer renders. No package.json change (no DEP CHANGE this round).
**T3 trigger scan:** consumes #610 fix round 3: flagged item `media`, `removed`, `respond_by`, `overdue`, target types `voice_note` and `win`; `GET /community/feed` wins contract (`user_id, display_name, title, description, created_at, is_mine`, legacy keys still read); `DELETE /community/wins/:id`; voice `DELETE /community/voice-notes/:id`. Round 4 also consumes the moderation decision `member_notice { stored, push }`, `GET /community/safety/notices`, `POST /community/safety/notices/:id/read`, and the voice upload codes. Must merge with or after #610.
**Bounded T1:** More > Community wins screen rewritten on the real contract (it rendered blank cards and "NaNd ago"); `src/constants/support.ts` added byte-identical to #324 (blob b288271a), see dependency.
**Builder/owner:** Claude Opus 5.5 (T4 builder). Round 2 by lane B-COPY. Owner: operator. Needs two independent audits (GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5, neither the builder) plus green CI. Not self-audited.
**Acceptance evidence:** jest suites below; CI on the head SHA. Device evidence owed by the device pass (flags set on a test build only): record a voice note in the Hall -> second account reports it -> coach queue plays it -> Hide; block from a voice note; delete own voice note and own win; share a win with a word-list term -> "Please rephrase" with draft kept; win report -> Hide.
**Promotion triggers:** any one-tap (unconfirmed) moderation or delete action; Block or Report shown on the viewer's own content, or Block on the viewer's coach's content; a voice note or win rendered anywhere without the safety menu; dropping the 422 draft-keeping behaviour; the coach queue failing closed on an unknown target type again. **No flag is flipped by this PR**: voice notes stay behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES` (Hall voice section, composer route); the operator flips it after both audits + device pass.

**Dependencies:** OR-109-1: the safety contact is the repo's one `SUPPORT_EMAIL` from `src/constants/support.ts`. That file is added here byte-identical to #324 (open, unmerged) so the two PRs merge cleanly in either order; `COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_EMAIL` and the safety fallback both read it. Backend #610 (merged with #631) serves the same address.

**Voice notes are delivered in this PR directly** (not a follow-up): Report, Block, author Delete on every voice note surface (Hall voice section and voice-note detail), coach-queue playback, 24-hour review status. **Audio cannot be text-filtered**: voice notes are not transcribed, so they rely on report + moderation. DM voice notes are not offered (the backend refuses them with `community.voice.dm_not_supported`).

---

## What was broken -> fixed
| Area | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Report | challenge comments only | every post, comment, challenge comment, DM message, voice note and win (one menu entry each, 8 reasons) |
| Block | none | menu on other members' content + DM header (not on the coach's content); two-way copy incl. voice notes; Unblock in Community safety |
| Delete own content | none on wins/voice | Delete with confirmation on own wins and voice notes |
| Coach moderation | Hide called non-existent routes; queue parse broke on voice/win items | PATCH moderation item with Hide/Warn/Ban/Dismiss, voice playback, 24-hour status |
| Wins screen | blank cards, "NaNd ago", no report/block | real contract, Report/Block/Delete, filtered post keeps the draft |
| Voice notes | not reportable | Hall voice section with Record, player, Report/Block/Delete; detail screen menu |
| Content filter | 422 shown as a generic failure | server "Please rephrase" message, draft kept |
| Safety contact | none | Community safety screen with guidelines, commitment, the one support address, block list |

## Known limits
- **Audio cannot be text-filtered**; voice notes rely on report + moderation.
- The voice feed has no author names (`VoiceNoteView` carries `author_id` only), so rows read "You" or "Member"; Block copy then says "this member".
- `viewerCoachId` comes from `useCurrentUser().coach_id`; while it loads, Block can briefly show on coach content and the server refusal explains it.
- Record/upload/playback has not been exercised on a device in this round (jest only); the device pass owns it before the flag flips.
- When `communityTab` is ON, More > Community (wins) and the Community tab share the "Community" label (pre-existing naming, not changed here).
- The filter is a word list, not a classifier.

Community safety screen falls back to these when `/community/safety` is unreachable (server copy still wins; empty server commitment now also falls back). Report confirmation reads: "Thank you. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours, every day, by your coach and The Growth Project team. Content that breaks these guidelines is removed, and people who break them repeatedly lose access." | b4b931d4 | `src/api/__tests__/communitySafetyApi.test.ts` (pins 24-hour sentence, full commitment, report message, safety email, rules 5 and 7, reason labels, no `!`); `CommunitySafetyScreen.test.tsx` (offline fallback renders all seven rules and the exact commitment); `SafetyMenu.test.tsx` (exact report confirmation text) |

Please try again", "Not sent", "Could not load your block list" (now with Try again), coach queue load copy, challenge "Something looks off ... Please try again shortly", space posts copy. ## Fix round 4 (lane B-UGC-3, agent 111): Sol audit @41d829d + Opus audit 2
Merged main e3986e89 into the branch first (merge commit 7927ea7, no rebase, no force).

**DEP CHANGE:** main shipped no audio module (no expo-audio, no expo-av). Added `expo-audio` `~56.0.12` (the Expo SDK 56 pin; lock resolves 56.0.13) to package.json + package-lock.json only (13 lock lines: the root dependency and the `node_modules/expo-audio` entry; its peers are already locked). `app.json` gains the `expo-audio` config plugin with the microphone permission text and background playback / recording off. **A new native build (EAS) is required** before voice works on a device; the JS loads expo-audio lazily, so an older binary shows the honest "not available on this build" state instead of crashing. Jest mocks the native module (`jest.expoAudioMock.js`, mapped in jest.setup.js).

| Finding ID | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-314-2 voice cannot record or play | New `src/services/voiceAudio.ts`: the production recorder (expo-audio `useAudioRecorder`, AAC .m4a mono 44.1 kHz 64 kbps with metering; mic permission read + request; start/stop/cancel; duration from the recorder, size from the file; peaks for the waveform; audio mode restored after recording) and the production player (`createAudioPlayer`, play/pause/seek/unload, status to the UI, silent-mode playback). `resolveVoiceRecorder` and the playback port now fall back to these native adapters by default, so the composer, the Hall voice section, the voice-note detail and the coach queue all record/play without any test-only registration. Recording is cancelled and the meter cleared when the composer unmounts mid-recording. Best-effort native cleanup failures go to Sentry | 4192ba9 | new `src/services/__tests__/voiceAudio.test.tsx` (7: the production resolution picks the native player and recorder with no registration; records an m4a with real duration, bytes, MIME and peaks; permission prompt vs permanent refusal to Settings; failed prepare is a recoverable error; unmount mid-recording releases the microphone; metering normalisation; peak downsampling); new `voiceAudioMissingModule.test.tsx` (binary without the module -> unavailable adapters, reported to Sentry once); `useVoiceRecorder.test.tsx`, `VoiceNoteComposer.test.tsx`, `VoiceNotesSection.test.tsx` green on the native default |
| B-314-3 mailto rejection unhandled | `CommunitySafetyScreen` awaits `Linking.openURL`; on rejection it says "No email app opened on this device...", shows the address as selectable text, offers Copy address (expo-clipboard) and Try again; copy failure says how to select it | 4192ba9 | `CommunitySafetyScreen.test.tsx` "keeps the address usable: what happened, selectable address, copy and retry", "says how to select the address when copying fails too" |
| B-314-4 safety unreachable from wins | `CommunitySafety` registered in the More stack (unconditional, not behind `communityTab`); the wins screen has a "Community safety" row and an unread-notice banner that open it; the screen shows Back when it was pushed | 4192ba9 | new `src/navigation/__tests__/communitySafetyFromWins.test.tsx`: real NavigationContainer + native stack, `communityTab` OFF: wins -> safety contact shown, block from a win -> on the blocked list -> Unblock -> Back -> feed refetched with the win restored; static check that the production More stack registers the route outside any flag gate; `CommunityWinsScreen.test.tsx` (+2) |
| B-314-5 refreshed signed URL never loaded | `VoiceNotePlayer` keys the loaded handle to its URL: a new URL unloads the old handle and the next Play loads the new one; a load/play error unloads the handle, tells the parent (`onPlaybackError`, which refetches the signed link) and shows "Could not play this voice note. Tap play to try again."; a late load for a replaced or unmounted player is unloaded, never resurrected | 4192ba9 | `VoiceNotePlayer.test.tsx` (+4: new URL releases the old clip and the next press plays the new URL; a failed clip is dropped so Retry reloads, and the parent is asked for a fresh URL; a load that resolves after the URL changed is released; unmount releases the clip) |
| B-314-6 "Warning sent." untrue | The coach queue reads the backend's `member_notice` (`stored`, `push`) and says only what happened: "Warning saved. The member reads it in Community safety in the app." (and the Hide / Ban equivalents); if the notice was not stored it says the report is closed but the member was not told, and to message them directly. Members see their notices (warn / hide / ban) in Community safety, marked read on view, with an unread banner on the wins screen | 4192ba9 | `coachCommunityScreens.test.tsx` (+4 rendered cases incl. not stored, asserts "Warning sent." is gone); `CommunitySafetyScreen.test.tsx` notices (shown + marked read once; load failure says what happened + Try again) |
| C-314-4 `community.dm.blocked` mapped but not emitted | Removed. Mapped codes now exported (`MAPPED_COMMUNITY_CODES`); added the voice upload codes the backend emits (`upload_missing`, `upload_mismatch`, `already_posted`, `storage_unavailable`) and `community.notice.not_found`; `community.dm.not_found` uses the server wording, so a blocked member sees the same as a missing conversation | 4192ba9 | new `src/api/__tests__/communityErrorsContract.test.ts` (every mapped code is in the backend's emitted list at #610 head; `dm.blocked` gone; blocked DM shows server wording; voice upload codes have specific copy) |

Tier re-check for this round: T4, unchanged (never lowered). New T4 surface: native microphone access (permission text in app.json, foreground only), member-visible moderation notices. Promotion triggers: none fired. **No flag is flipped**: voice notes stay behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES`.

Tests run this round (heavy.sh, `--runInBand`), head 4192ba9:
```
heavy.sh npx tsc --noEmit (worktree tsconfig + local-only path to the real expo-audio 56.0.13 types; CI installs it from the lock): clean
heavy.sh npx eslint --max-warnings=0 <26 changed files>: 0 errors (only warning: jest.setup.js is ignored by the repo's own ignore pattern)
heavy.sh npx jest --ci --runInBand --forceExit src/screens/community/__tests__ src/components/community/__tests__ src/navigation/__tests__ src/hooks/__tests__ src/services/__tests__/voiceAudio* src/api/__tests__/{communitySafetyApi,communityWinsApi,communityErrorsContract}.test.ts src/api/coachCommunityApi.test.ts src/screens/client/__tests__/CommunityWinsScreen.test.tsx src/__tests__/quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts src/__tests__/wave11Screens.test.tsx src/config/__tests__/declaredDependencies.test.ts src/config/__tests__/androidHealthConnectConfig.test.js src/__tests__/iosStorePackagePurchasePosture.test.tsx
  91 suites, 942 passed
no `as any` / `as unknown as` / `as never` / empty `.catch(() => undefined)` added
(--forceExit locally only: two timers opened by importing @sentry/react-native keep a --runInBand process alive; pre-existing, CI uses workers)
CI on 4192ba9: Typecheck, lint, test pass (CI installs expo-audio 56.0.13 from the lock); Analyze (javascript-typescript) pass; Analyze (actions) pass; CodeQL pass
```
Known limits (unchanged by tests): record and playback are exercised against the jest double of expo-audio, not a device. The device pass must record -> upload -> second member reports -> coach plays in the queue -> Hide / Warn / Ban -> block both ways -> author delete, on a build that includes expo-audio. Push deep links `tgp://community/moderation` and `tgp://community/safety` are not routed by the app yet (opening the push lands on the app's current screen).

## Fix round 5 (lane B-UGC-4, agent 112): Sol + Opus on 4192ba9d

Main 2c17c241 merged (merge commit a532b0b, clean, package.json and lock unchanged). Fix commit bf5faaa7; test fixes f24021ca, 48d76d21. CI at 48d76d21: Typecheck, lint, test and CodeQL all pass.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (fails on 4192ba9d) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-314-7: recorder start had no fence across unmount; permission rejections escaped; recording audio mode was not restored on failure | `useVoiceRecorder`: start is single-flight (`startingRef`) and fenced by a generation bumped on unmount, cancel and reset. A start that lands after retirement is cancelled. Permission reads and requests run inside try and end in a coded `error` (`permission_check` / `start` / `stop`) with a short reference, reported to Sentry. `voiceAudio`: a failed prepare/record restores playback mode before rethrowing; stop restores it in `finally`. Composer shows kind-specific copy, Try again, the support email and the reference | bf5faaa7 | `useVoiceRecorderLifecycle.test.tsx` (unmount during a held start cancels and leaves no ticker; unmount during a held permission read never starts; a double tap starts once; rejected permission read, permission request, start and stop each give a coded error). `voiceAudio.test.tsx` (failed prepare and failed stop restore playback mode; a rejected expo-audio permission read is a coded error; unmount during a held prepare stops the late capture). `VoiceNoteComposer.test.tsx` (error notice, reference, Try again) |
| B-314-8: two Play taps during loading created two handles and orphaned one | `VoiceNotePlayer`: `loadingRef` single flight set synchronously and keyed to the generation; a URL change or unmount ends it; any previously adopted handle is unloaded on replacement; the control is disabled and busy while loading | bf5faaa7, f24021ca, 48d76d21 | `VoiceNotePlayer.test.tsx` "B-314-8": two same-frame taps load once, play once and release on unmount; disabled while loading; a URL change while loading releases the stale load; unmount while loading releases the late handle |
| #610 round 5 contract | `communityErrors`: the two new 409 codes (already_actioned is server-worded) | bf5faaa7 | `communityErrorsContract.test.ts` (both codes listed as backend-emitted; three mapping cases) |

Failing-before, executed: the round 5 tests were run with the five source files checked out at 4192ba9d (useVoiceRecorder, voiceAudio, VoiceNotePlayer, VoiceNoteComposer, communityErrors). 19 of the 20 new cases failed. The one that passed, unmount while loading releases the late handle, is a regression guard that the round 3 generation fence already covered. With the fixed sources the same files pass locally (VoiceNotePlayer 11/11) and in CI.

Release note: expo-audio is native. Voice notes need a new EAS build and a device pass before `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES` is turned on.
